title: Location of Curb Cuts
previewText: In all districts, for zoning lots existing on March 22, 2018, with frontage along Edward L. Grant Highway, West 170th Street, or the portions of Jerome or River Avenues with an elevated rail structure, and fronting along other streets, no curb cut accessing off-street parking spaces or loading spaces shall be permitted along such streets, as applicable.
